notifications.title: The weekly market scan doesn't run for How Tech Works
notifications.detail: The market-data branch holds only Paisa Panchayat's finance scan, so research for this channel has no list of this week's fastest-growing tech Shorts. Tonight it used the setup scan on the niche-data branch (18 Nov) instead, which will go stale.
notifications.fix: 1. Make market.yml (or its caller) run workers/market.ts once per active channel with CHANNEL=<slug>, writing each channel's results to its own file on market-data. 2. Give channels/how-tech-and-ai-actually-work-chips-ai-p/market.json the full MarketConfig fields (days, regionCode, regions) next to its queries. 3. Mind the quota: each search costs 100 units.
